title: Review: Talking Technology — Five Words to Consolidate

review_words.meaning_zh: 无处不在的，普遍存在的
review_words.key_point_zh: 阅读中常与 widespread、omnipresent 构成同义替换；写作谈科技普及时可用来替代口语化的 everywhere。
review_words.example: Contactless payment has become ubiquitous in cities, from corner shops to vending machines.
review_words.translation_zh: 非接触式支付在城市里已无处不在，从街角小店到自动售货机都能用。
review_words.note_zh: become ubiquitous 是高频搭配，强调从少到多的普及过程，而不是单纯的“很多”。

review_words.key_point_zh: 学术语境中多作形容词，与 innovative、original 同义替换；辨析题常拿它和名词“小说”义混淆。
review_words.example: The company tested a novel way of cooling data centres by pumping seawater through pipes.
review_words.translation_zh: 这家公司试验了一种新颖的数据中心降温方式：用管道抽取海水来冷却。
review_words.note_zh: a novel way / approach / method of doing sth 是学术写作中常见的褒义搭配。

review_words.key_point_zh: 修饰 evidence、system、growth 时表示“有力、可靠”，阅读中与 strong、sound 同义替换，与“粗鲁”无关。
review_words.example: Regulators need robust safeguards before self-driving cars are allowed on public roads.
review_words.translation_zh: 在允许自动驾驶汽车上公共道路之前，监管机构需要有力的保障措施。
review_words.note_zh: robust safeguards / evidence / system 是正式搭配；注意它不表示“耐用度”以外的“粗鲁”。

review_words.key_point_zh: address the problem / issue 表“着手解决”，阅读中与 tackle、deal with 同义替换，切勿只记“地址”。
review_words.example: Few platforms have addressed the question of what happens to users' data after they delete an account.
review_words.translation_zh: 很少有平台认真回应过这样一个问题：用户注销账号后，他们的数据会怎样。
review_words.note_zh: address 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 to 或 with；address a question / concern 为正式搭配。

review_words.meaning_zh: 几乎，差不多；以线上方式
review_words.key_point_zh: 阅读判断题常把它改写为 almost、nearly；谈会议或课程时也可表示“以线上形式”。
review_words.example: Virtually all university applications are now submitted online.
review_words.translation_zh: 现在几乎所有大学申请都是在线提交的。
review_words.note_zh: virtually all / every + 名词表示“几乎所有”，语气比 almost 略正式、更书面。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you read that piece about smart speakers in the home?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and it's striking how ubiquitous they've become in just a few years. My parents even use one to switch off the lights.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Same in my flat. But the article raised a concern the industry hasn't really addressed: what actually happens to all the recordings?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the part I found worrying. Voice data is virtually impossible to remove once it's been passed to a third party.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A couple of start-ups are trying a novel approach, though — processing speech on the device itself instead of in the cloud.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising, but it will need robust testing before people trust it with anything sensitive.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Agreed. Still, it's a step in the right direction.

quiz.question: In the sentence 'The team came up with a novel approach to reducing e-waste', 'novel' most nearly means:
quiz.explanation_zh: novel 作形容词表示“新颖的”，与 innovative、original 同义替换；只有“小说”这一名词义，此处不适用。

quiz.question: The company has promised to ______ the privacy concerns raised by users.
quiz.explanation_zh: address 表示“处理、应对”时是及物动词，直接接宾语，不加介词：address the concerns / the issue。

quiz.question: ______ every student in the class now uses a laptop for taking notes.
quiz.explanation_zh: virtually every 表示“几乎每一个”，阅读中常被改写为 almost / nearly；ubiquitous 是形容词，不能修饰 every。
